location_address: 2720 Shelter Island Drive San Diego, CA US 92106
description:
Begin your weekend the San Diego way, sailing on calm waters with a mimosa in hand. This 2-hour morning sail is the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Enjoy the ocean breeze, sip bubbly with fresh juice, and soak up the calmest, most relaxing part of the day. Cheers to your new weekend ritual!  🥂 

**A minimum of 10 tickets must be sold to leave the docks**
what_is_included:
The Mimosa Club includes: 

🌊 A 2-hour sail along San Diego’s stunning coastline

🥂 Bottomless mimosas, perfectly chilled

⛵ A beautiful, spacious 50’ sailing yacht

✨ Your new favorite way to kick off the weekend
